about_the_game:
Jack is alone in the woods, a night of camping takes a turn for the unexplainable. What begins as a quiet getaway is interrupted by something that should not exist.  Every death is another opportunity to do it right the next time and escape the entity. Every death changes the woods not always for the best. Game was originally designed as a short experience for a 4 day gamejam. This is the full cut with longer full story more lore and scares and polished gameplay.

Features:

  • Atmospheric Exploration – Explore your campsite and discover what monster resides in these woods.

  • Psychological Horror – A creepy decent into a cat and mouse game with a entity.

  • Immersive Horror Design – Dark visuals and creepy soundscapes keep you on edge.

  • Unique Gameplay - Every time you die you find new tools and ways to escape the nightmare

WARNING:

Epileptic seizures associated with increased sensitivity to light are Possible. Some people may experience seizures when exposed to flashes of light and flashing images that appear in a video game. People who have not previously experienced such attacks may not be aware of their illness. A reasonable restriction of the game audience is recommended
